segments.text: You sat down to study. Two hours later, you have watched forty videos.
So why does your brain keep doing this to you?
Here is the twist: procrastination is usually about managing emotions, not managing time.
When a task feels boring, confusing or stressful, avoiding it gives you quick relief.
The fix? Make the first step tiny, so starting is easy.
Open the document. Write one sentence. That is it.
And when you do slip up, go easy on yourself.
Being kind to yourself is linked with procrastinating less next time.
So go do that tiny first step. Right now.
